tldr: 台積電法說後多家外資調高目標價至最高 4,200 元，資本支出上修至 600–640 億美元，AI 需求能見度看到 2029–2030 年。
保險業 2026 年正式接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS），金控獲准延後申報集團資本適足率以保留調適彈性。
國際氣氛轉趨審慎：10 年期美債殖利率飆至 19 年高、逼近 5.14%，10 月聯準會升息機率升破 66%，壓抑美股與台積電 ADR。
台灣前 8 月稅收創新高 3.07 兆元、證交稅暴增為主力，央行則連 10 凍維持利率不變。

items.title_zh: 台積電領軍，台股收 48,157.29 點寫新高
items.title_en: TAIEX sets fresh record high above 48,000, led by TSMC
items.summary_zh: 加權指數 9 月 23 日漲 357.12 點、0.75%，收在歷史新高 48,157.29 點，成交值約 8,559 億元。台積電漲 40 元、1.63% 至 2,500 元，貢獻約 320 點。外資及陸資買超 373 億元、自營商買超 58 億元，但個股上漲家數少於下跌家數，顯示行情由權值股集中拉抬、個股並未全面跟漲。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 357.12 points, or 0.75%, to close at a record 48,157.29 on Sept 23, with turnover of about NT$855.9bn. TSMC gained NT$40 (1.63%) to NT$2,500, contributing roughly 320 index points. Foreign and mainland investors net-bought NT$37.3bn while dealers added NT$5.8bn, though gainers trailed decliners among individual stocks, signalling a narrow, index-heavyweight-driven advance.

items.title_zh: 台積電法說後外資上調目標價，最高喊 4,200 元
items.title_en: Foreign brokers raise TSMC targets to as high as NT$4,200 after earnings call
items.summary_zh: 台積電繳出財報優於預期、展望上修，多家外資調升目標價，最高看至 4,200 元。外資認為資本支出上修至 600–640 億美元是信心訊號而非盲目擴產，AI 需求由 GPU 擴散至 CPU、客製化 ASIC 與網通晶片，且來自真實資料中心建置，能見度延伸至 2029–2030 年。
items.summary_en: Following TSMC's results and guidance, several foreign houses lifted price targets, the most bullish reaching NT$4,200. Analysts framed the capex hike to US$60–64bn as a confidence signal rather than over-expansion, noting AI demand is broadening from GPUs to CPUs, custom ASICs and networking chips, with visibility extending to 2029–2030 driven by real data-centre build-out rather than inventory stocking.

items.title_zh: AI 伺服器建置擴大台灣供應鏈需求
items.title_en: AI server build-out broadens Taiwan supply-chain demand beyond GPUs
items.summary_zh: AI 題材由 GPU、AI 伺服器延燒至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB/CCL、電源供應與 48V 高壓供電、HBM/CoWoS、CPO/矽光子。高階玻纖布、銅箔供應吃緊，支撐 PCB 廠量價齊揚，也凸顯台廠在先進製程、封裝、光通訊、測試與廠務工程等多環節的關鍵地位。
items.summary_en: The AI theme is spreading from GPUs and AI servers to rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply and 48V high-voltage delivery, HBM/CoWoS, and CPO/silicon photonics. High-end glass fabric and copper foil remain tight, supporting a "volume-and-price" upswing for Taiwan's PCB makers and reinforcing the island's role across advanced process, packaging, optical, testing and fab-engineering niches.

items.title_zh: AI 拉動供應鏈外移，台廠加碼美國半導體投資
items.title_en: Taiwan chipmakers deepen US investment as AI pulls supply chain overseas
items.summary_zh: 報導指出台灣晶片廠再加碼約 200 億美元投資美國半導體產能，AI 伺服器需求把先進封裝到材料等整條供應鏈拉向美國。此舉凸顯 AI 競爭已從單一晶片進入生態系之爭，也引發成本、在地化及台灣本土附加價值留存比重的討論。
items.summary_en: Reports point to Taiwanese chip firms committing an additional US$20bn to US semiconductor capacity, as surging AI-server demand drags the broader supply chain—from advanced packaging to materials—toward American fabs. The shift underscores how AI competition has moved from single chips to whole ecosystems, raising questions over cost, localisation and how much value-add stays onshore in Taiwan.

items.title_zh: 保險業 2026 年接軌新一代清償能力制度，設過渡彈性
items.title_en: Insurers adopt new-generation solvency (TIS) regime in 2026 with phased flexibility
items.summary_zh: 台灣保險業 2026 年正式接軌新一代清償能力制度（對接 TW-ICS/IFRS 17），提升監理標準。為緩解衝擊，金管會修正金控資本適足性管理辦法，增訂但書，允許有壽險子公司的金控延後一個月申報集團資本適足率（CAR），降低初期調適壓力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's insurance sector formally moves to the new-generation solvency system (aligned with TW-ICS/IFRS 17) in 2026, upgrading supervisory standards. To ease the transition, the FSC's revised financial-holding capital-adequacy rules let holding companies with life-insurance subsidiaries defer group capital-adequacy (CAR) reporting by a month, cushioning early adjustment pressure across the industry.

items.title_zh: 金管會主委：符合 4 條件樂見金控整併
items.title_en: FSC chief sets conditions for financial-holding mergers
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆重申，只要符合四項條件即樂見金控整併，同時如期於 2026 年推動保險業會計與清償能力「雙接軌」。此一立場在資本規範趨嚴之際仍為業界併購保留空間，牽動金控在資本、併購與股利策略上的規劃。
items.summary_en: FSC chairman Peng Jin-long reiterated the regulator would welcome financial-holding consolidation provided four conditions are met, while pressing ahead with the insurance sector's twin accounting-and-solvency transition in 2026. The stance keeps the door open to industry mergers even as capital rules tighten, shaping how holding groups plan capital, M&A and dividend strategy into the new regime.

items.title_zh: 9 月新基金募集潮，主動式 ETF 領銜
items.title_en: September fund-raising wave: five new funds, active ETFs to the fore
items.summary_zh: 9 月有 5 檔新基金開募，其中 3 檔為 ETF、2 檔為主動式：訴求台股核心 50 強的主動群益核心 50（00415A），以及聚焦台韓日半導體的主動安聯亞半導體（00412A），另有街口非投等債 ETF（00992B）與 2 檔多重資產基金。自 2025 年開放以來，主動式 ETF 已達 40 檔掛牌。
items.summary_en: Five new funds opened for subscription in September, including three ETFs—two of them active: the Capital Core 50 active ETF (00415A) targeting top Taiwan large-caps, and the Allianz Asia Semiconductor active ETF (00412A) focused on Taiwan, Korea and Japan chip names—plus a high-yield non-investment-grade bond ETF (00992B) and two multi-asset funds. Taiwan now has 40 listed active ETFs since the 2025 opening.

items.title_zh: 臺灣銀行啟動高資產服務團隊
items.title_en: Bank of Taiwan launches high-net-worth service platform
items.summary_zh: 臺灣銀行成立高資產專業服務團隊，整合投資、信託、保險、授信、外匯及黃金業務（含黃金現貨指定保管），協助客戶處理資產傳承、企業接班、跨境資產安排與家族治理。此舉深化國內銀行搶攻高資產客群的競爭，並呼應台灣推動亞洲資產管理中心的政策方向。
items.summary_en: Bank of Taiwan unveiled a high-asset professional service team integrating investment, trust, insurance, credit, FX and gold—including a physical-gold designated-custody service—to help clients tackle wealth succession, business handover, cross-border asset arrangements and family governance. The move deepens competition among domestic banks for high-net-worth clients as Taiwan pushes its regional asset-management centre agenda.

items.title_zh: 前 8 月稅收破 3 兆，證交稅暴增挑大樑
items.title_en: Taiwan's Jan–Aug tax take tops NT$3tn on a securities-tax surge
items.summary_zh: 財政部公布 8 月全國賦稅收入 1,982 億元、年增 28.9%，累計前 8 月達新高 3 兆 749 億元、年增 25.2%。主力為證交稅：8 月 540 億元、年增 94.5%，連 13 紅，前 8 月狂收 4,527 億元、暴增約 1.7 倍，反映股市日均量近乎倍增。官員稱新財劃法下地方有望領「超徵紅包」。
items.summary_en: The finance ministry reported August tax revenue of NT$198.2bn (+28.9% YoY), lifting the eight-month total to a record NT$3.07tn (+25.2%). Securities transaction tax did the heavy lifting: NT$54bn in August (+94.5%) for a 13th straight monthly gain, and NT$452.7bn year-to-date—up about 1.7x—as average daily turnover nearly doubled. Officials hinted local governments may see an "over-collection bonus" under the new fiscal-allocation law.

items.title_zh: 營所稅暫繳 9 月 1 日至 30 日申報繳納
items.title_en: Provisional corporate income tax due Sept 1–30
items.summary_zh: 財政部提醒，在中華民國境內有固定營業場所的營利事業，應於 9 月依規定辦理 2026 年度營利事業所得稅暫繳申報及繳納，暫繳稅額原則為上年度結算應納稅額之半數。國稅局籲請業者於月底截止前完成網路申報與繳稅，逾期將加徵滯納金，可多加利用線上試算與繳納服務。
items.summary_en: Profit-seeking enterprises with a fixed place of business in Taiwan must file and pay their 2026 provisional corporate income tax during September, generally half of the prior year's assessed tax. The National Tax Bureau reminded firms to complete e-filing and payment before the month-end deadline to avoid surcharges, with online channels available for calculation and remittance.

items.title_zh: 央行連 10 凍，上修 2026 成長率
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates for a 10th straight meeting, lifts 2026 growth forecast
items.summary_zh: 央行 9 月 17 日維持政策利率 2%、連 10 凍，但 15 名理事中有 2 人主張升息。央行同時將 2026 年經濟成長率預測上修至 11.48%，CPI 估值上調至 2.03%。決策者以「外熱內溫」、K 型分歧描述景氣，警示過度緊縮恐加重中小企業與傳統產業負擔，故按兵不動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its policy rate at 2% on Sept 17—its 10th consecutive hold—though two of 15 board members favoured a hike. It raised the 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.48% and nudged its CPI estimate up to 2.03%. Policymakers cited an "externally hot, internally warm" economy with K-shaped divergence, warning that further tightening could strain SMEs and traditional industries.

items.title_zh: 國泰台大團隊上修 GDP 至 11.6%，估央行不動
items.title_en: Cathay-NTU team lifts Taiwan GDP forecast to 11.6%, sees rate hold
items.summary_zh: 國泰金與台大團隊將 2026 年台灣經濟成長率預測上修至 11.6%，主要動能來自 AI 帶動的出口與投資，並預期央行 9 月維持利率不變。此一上修凸顯 AI 相關需求正拉高整體成長數字，但內需導向產業表現相對落後，央行對通膨仍持審慎態度。
items.summary_en: The Cathay Financial and National Taiwan University research team raised its 2026 Taiwan GDP growth forecast to 11.6%, powered by AI-driven exports and investment, while projecting the central bank would leave rates unchanged in September. The upgrade underscores how AI-related demand is skewing headline growth, even as domestic-facing sectors lag and the bank stays cautious on inflation.

items.title_zh: 油價漲、美債殖利率創高，美股三大指數收黑
items.title_en: US stocks fall as oil climbs and Treasury yields hit fresh highs
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，國際油價走揚、10 年期美債殖利率飆至多年新高，重燃聯準會續緊縮疑慮，美股三大指數同步收黑，台積電 ADR 下跌約 1%。此走勢為亞股盤前定調偏審慎，本地法人示警美債殖利率壓力將是牽動台股的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported that all three major US indices closed lower as oil prices rose and the 10-year Treasury yield spiked to a multi-year high, reviving fears of further Fed tightening. TSMC's ADR slipped about 1%. The moves set a cautious tone for Asian trading, with local desks flagging bond-yield pressure as the key swing factor for Taiwan equities.

items.title_zh: 聯準會升息、美股收黑，法人：台股留意美債殖利率
items.title_en: After the Fed's hike, analysts tell Taiwan to watch Treasury yields
items.summary_zh: 聯準會升息後，台灣法人示警，真正牽動台股的風險並非升息本身，而是持續攀升的美債殖利率。殖利率走高將提高高評價科技股的折現率，並可能觸發外資調節，本地策略師因此建議投資人在研判台股動能時，密切追蹤 10 年期美債殖利率變化。
items.summary_en: Following the Federal Reserve's rate increase, Taiwanese analysts warned that surging US bond yields, rather than the hike itself, pose the bigger risk to Taiwan's equity market. Higher yields lift discount rates on richly valued tech names and can spur foreign outflows, so local strategists urged investors to track the 10-year yield closely when gauging TAIEX momentum.

items.title_zh: 10 年期美債殖利率飆至 19 年高（2026-09-23）
items.summary_zh: 10 年期美債殖利率單日跳升逾 13 個基點至約 5.135%，創 2007 年 7 月以來新高，為近 18 個月最大單日漲幅。推手包括強勁製造業調查、聯準會鷹派談話、五年期標售需求疲弱及油價走堅（WTI 漲約 2%）。美股同步下挫，道瓊跌逾 350 點、標普 500 跌 0.8%、那斯達克跌 1.1%。
items.summary_en: The 10-year US Treasury yield jumped more than 13 basis points to about 5.135%, its highest since July 2007, in the biggest one-day move in nearly 18 months. Drivers included hot manufacturing surveys, hawkish Fed commentary, a weak five-year note auction and firm oil, with WTI up roughly 2%. Stocks fell: the Dow slid over 350 points, the S&P 500 lost 0.8% and the Nasdaq shed 1.1%.

items.title_zh: 巴爾談話後，市場押注 10 月聯準會再升息（2026-09-23）
items.title_en: Market bets on an October Fed hike after Barr comments (2026-09-23)
items.summary_zh: 據 CME FedWatch，10 月聯準會升息 1 碼機率升破 66%，高於前一日的 55%、一個月前的不到 9%。聯準會理事巴爾在講稿中表示「可能仍需進一步調整政策」以使通膨回到目標，加上最新數據顯示物價壓力升溫，強化市場對鷹派路線的預期。
items.summary_en: Odds of a quarter-point Fed rate increase in October climbed above 66% on the CME FedWatch tool—up from 55% a day earlier and under 9% a month ago—after Governor Michael Barr said in prepared remarks that "further policy adjustments are likely to be needed" to bring inflation to target. Fresh data showing intensifying price pressures reinforced the hawkish shift.

items.title_zh: 升息推升年輕世代借貸成本（2026-09-23）
items.title_en: Fed rate hike raises borrowing costs for younger workers (2026-09-23)
items.summary_zh: 隨聯準會升息、殖利率飆升，CNBC 報導信用卡、車貸與房貸等借貸成本走高，對年輕族群衝擊最大。若 10 年期殖利率持續站上 5% 以上，恐使房市、商用不動產及高負債企業的脆弱性浮現，凸顯緊縮循環正從華爾街外溢至一般家庭財務。
items.summary_en: With the Fed lifting rates and yields surging, CNBC reported that borrowing costs are climbing for credit cards, auto loans and mortgages, hitting younger workers hardest. A sustained 5%-plus 10-year yield could expose vulnerabilities in housing, commercial real estate and heavily indebted firms, underscoring how the tightening cycle ripples from Wall Street into household budgets.

items.title_zh: 債市下跌，反成投資人節稅良機（2026-09-23）
items.title_en: Bond losses hand investors a tax-savings opportunity (2026-09-23)
items.summary_zh: 隨美債殖利率飆升、債券價格下挫，CNBC 指出這波賣壓帶來可觀的「稅損收割」空間：持有固定收益帳面虧損的投資人可實現損失以抵減資本利得，再以當前較高殖利率重新布局。理財顧問表示，若操作得當，可將債市回檔轉化為較長期的稅後效益。
items.summary_en: As Treasury yields surge and bond prices fall, CNBC noted the sell-off creates sizeable tax-loss harvesting opportunities: investors sitting on paper losses in fixed income can realise them to offset capital gains, then reinvest at today's higher yields. Advisers say the strategy can turn a painful bond drawdown into a longer-term after-tax benefit if executed carefully.
